task_instructions: In dist/save-cache/index.cjs, bundling transforms ReserveCacheError into class _ReserveCacheError. Consequently, ReserveCacheError.name becomes '_ReserveCacheError', while instances have name === 'ReserveCacheError'. The check typedError.name === ReserveCacheError.name fails, causing expected concurrent cache reservation races to be logged as warning annotations in GitHub Actions. Fix the error handling to correctly recognize ReserveCacheError.
expected_behavior: When a ReserveCacheError occurs during cache save, the handler must match it as a benign race and log via info rather than emitting a warning annotation.
